summary: SM UC-28 was a German Type UC II minelaying submarine (U-boat) of the Imperial German Navy during World War I. It was ordered on 29 August 1915, launched on 8 July 1916, and commissioned on 6 August 1916. The note states that the boat sank no ships in its patrols, and that it surrendered to France on 12 February 1919 and was broken up.
one_line: SM UC-28 was a German Type UC II minelaying U-boat of World War I that sank no ships and was surrendered to France in 1919.
